It is not construction start, completion, compliance sign-off, final physical condition, preservation outcome, or full approved-work geometry evidence. WorkTypes are source category text and may summarize rather than fully describe the scope; rows can be refreshed or corrected after retrieval.
candidates.transformation_method: scripts/fetch_round626_nyc_lpc_permit_next102_candidates.js queried official NYC Open Data dpm2-m9mq rows with issue_date from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-23, required official latitude/longitude and regulation_number, scored architecture-facing WorkTypes/regulation_type values, deduplicated against the current corpus plus prior LPC permit/designation packs through round624, and selected up to 200 high-signal administrative milestones without inferring physical work.
